decision: A jumper setting the product page leaves unlabelled takes its label only from the maker's own manual, linked from that page, when the manual states the same draws under a named jumper position. Nothing is inferred.

labels.name: Otool Scope and Audio Tools
labels.label: With rear jumper set to Internal 5v
labels.quote: With rear jumper set to Internal 5v you supply no external five volts. Power: 80ma +12v 22ma -12v

labels.name: Otool Scope and Audio Tools
labels.label: With rear jumper set to External 5v
labels.quote: With rear jumper set to External 5v you supply five volts on the power ribbon, as well as +/-12v. Power: 12ma +12v 70ma +5v 22ma -12v

not_settled.name: Spectral Multiband Resonator
not_settled.reason: Neither the product page nor the linked firmware-v5 notes name the base jumper position; only 'when jumper set to +12V' is named.

not_settled.name: 4ms VCA Matrix
not_settled.reason: The page still gives '80 max' for +12V with jumper selecting external 5V, with no unit, and links no manual.
